title: Women's Pilates – Just Two More (She Lied) Tee
hook: A woman in a headband holds a perfect straight leg lift on a Pilates reformer, serene smile, legs shaking, one drop of sweat flying, and the shirt says JUST TWO MORE. (she lied). This pilates shirt is for the class regular and the instructor's favorite victim, in the studio, at brunch after class or any day the shakes are part of it.
art: The print is a 1960s exercise-record-sleeve scene: a woman with wavy blond hair, a navy headband, a rose leotard and navy tights lying back on a rose and mint reformer with its spring and rope pulleys, legs straight up and trembling with little wobble marks. JUST TWO MORE. sits above in navy slab capitals and (she lied) below in rose script.
wear: Wear it to class, the post-workout coffee or a Sunday walk, and give it to the Pilates friend who has been promised just two more every week.
qa: What is the Just Two More (She Lied) tee?

It is a women's relaxed tee from Graphic Tees Co. showing a vintage Pilates reformer leg lift with a trembling smile, lettered JUST TWO MORE. (she lied). It is printed on a Bella+Canvas 6400 in 4.2 oz cotton, so it stays light and soft in a warm studio.
How does the women's relaxed tee fit?

This Graphic Tees Co. tee is a relaxed women's cut in sizes S through 3XL with side seams and a crew neck. Order your usual size for an easy fit or size up for a looser, oversized look. If the size is off, the first exchange is free.
What is it made of and how do I wash it?

The tee is 100% combed, ring-spun cotton, with heather colors blending in some polyester, at a lightweight 4.2 oz. Wash it inside out in cold water with like colors and tumble dry low. That keeps the navy and rose inks crisp wash after wash.
Is it a good gift for a Pilates lover?

Yes. It suits the Pilates regular, the instructor and the friend who texts you after every class. It comes from Graphic Tees Co. at $24.99 in five colors, sizes S through 3XL, and the free size exchange makes it safe to give for a birthday, a studio party or Christmas.
Can I get it by Christmas?

Order by about December 8 and your Graphic Tees Co. Pilates tee should arrive before Christmas. Each shirt is printed the day you order it, so ship times vary a little by location. Orders over $45 ship free, and the free size exchange covers a wrong guess.
